permissions.//: Checked into the repo, so it applies to everyone who opens this project. Keep it to commands that only read state or run this project's own scripts. `defaultMode: default` means anything not listed here is confirmed by a human first — do not set it to auto/bypassPermissions here; put personal conveniences in .claude/settings.local.json, which is gitignored.
permissions.//deny: Two families of option turn an otherwise read-only command into a write or an execution, which is why the entries above are spelled out rather than wildcarded. git: `--output=<path>` writes a file anywhere the user can write, and `--ext-diff` runs whatever `diff.<driver>.command` names — both reachable from diff, log and show, and both verified. node: `--require`/`--import` preload and execute a module before the script does anything, so even `node --check` runs code. A trailing wildcard cannot exclude an option that may appear at any argument position, so these deny rules are the backstop for a wildcard finding its way back in.
